data.citation: Chen et al., J. Comput. Biophys. Chem. (2025), doi:10.1142/S2737416525500164
data.structures: RCSB mmCIF fetched 2026-11-05 by scripts/pka/pkadr.py fetch (model 1)
data.normalization: scripts/pka/pkadr.py normalize: numeric pKa only, PDB-mapped, SNase as stress holdout
data.cluster_definition: union of PDB id, PKAD-R 'Sequence_Identity_>_30%' and 'Alternative_PDBs' links, and identical protein name

held_out_results.selection_rule: train-split MAE minimum, fixed before inspecting test or stress rows
held_out_results.caveat: Not fully blind: test and SNase metrics of an earlier fit were inspected during development, and the solvent-exclusion fix (waters ignored by burial/H-bond terms) was found while diagnosing them. Parameters themselves were selected on train rows only. Treat these numbers as development estimates; a fresh holdout is needed for acceptance.
